lines.zh: 我捧着蜡烛，走进队伍第三个位置。
lines.en: I carry a candle and take third place in line.

lines.zh: 前面的人走多快，我就走多快。
lines.en: I walk as fast as the one ahead of me.

lines.zh: 袍子太长，我提着下摆小跑。
lines.en: My robe is too long; I gather the hem and trot.

lines.zh: 队伍绕回廊一圈，再回祭坛。
lines.en: The procession circles the colonnade, then returns.

lines.zh: 蜡油滴到手背，我不敢停。
lines.en: Wax drips on my hand; I dare not stop.

lines.zh: 我数着步子，怕踩错节奏。
lines.en: I count my steps, afraid to break the rhythm.

lines.zh: 香炉该换灰了，我抱得很稳。
lines.en: The censer needs fresh ash; I hold it steady.

lines.zh: 有人掉了念珠，我替他拾起。
lines.en: Someone drops their beads; I pick them up for him.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头有光，我们朝那儿走。
lines.en: There is light at the corridor's end; we walk toward it.

lines.zh: 我走在最后，负责关门。
lines.en: I walk last and see to the doors.

lines.zh: 鞋底薄，石英地硌得脚疼。
lines.en: My soles are thin; the quartz floor aches my feet.

lines.zh: 传道徒抬手，我们就换方向。
lines.en: The apostle raises a hand, and we turn.

lines.zh: 我把蜡烛换了只手，手心全是汗。
lines.en: I switch the candle to my other hand, palm sweating.

lines.zh: 训诫第七条的词，我又背错了。
lines.en: I misremember the seventh line of the doctrine again.

lines.zh: 今天轮到我添灯油。
lines.en: Today it is my turn to fill the lamps.

lines.zh: 我偷偷看讲台，那里还空着。
lines.en: I steal a look at the pulpit; it is still empty.

lines.zh: 我数了数，队伍里少两个人。
lines.en: I count the line: two of us are missing.

lines.zh: 香烧到一半，烟往我这边偏。
lines.en: Half the incense is gone, and the smoke leans my way.

lines.zh: 我练习低头的角度，练了很久。
lines.en: I practice the angle of bowing, for a long while.

lines.zh: 只要不说话，就没人会注意我。
lines.en: As long as I stay quiet, no one notices me.

lines.zh: 我把袍角上的灰拍干净了。
lines.en: I brush the ash from the hem of my robe.

lines.zh: 上面那层的门，我一次没进过。
lines.en: I have never once entered the door on the upper tier.

lines.zh: 你不是队伍里的，我数得清。
lines.en: You are not in the procession; I can count.

lines.zh: 别站在我旁边，会被看见的。
lines.en: Do not stand beside me; we will be seen.

lines.zh: 你的衣服太亮了，这里不该这样。
lines.en: Your clothes are too bright; that is wrong here.

lines.zh: 我该喊人，可我在犹豫。
lines.en: I ought to call someone, but I hesitate.

lines.zh: 你也听见钟声了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear the bell as well?

lines.zh: 传道徒在看这边，你快走。
lines.en: The apostle is looking this way; go quickly.

lines.zh: 我手里的蜡烛照不清你的脸。
lines.en: My candle is too weak to show your face.

lines.zh: 你是来献东西的，还是来拿的？
lines.en: Did you come to give, or to take?

lines.zh: 我低下头，可眼睛还在看你。
lines.en: I lower my head, but my eyes stay on you.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，这里不该有人笑。
lines.en: Why do you smile? No one smiles here.

lines.zh: 我倒退着撞翻了灯架。
lines.en: I stumble backward and knock over the lamp stand.

lines.zh: 别打脸，传道徒会看出来。
lines.en: Not the face; the apostle will notice.

lines.zh: 血滴在石头上，我得擦掉。
lines.en: Blood drips on the stone; I must wipe it.

lines.zh: 我咬着袖子，不出声。
lines.en: I bite my sleeve and make no sound.

lines.zh: 这一下比鞭子轻多了。
lines.en: That hurt less than the lash does.

lines.zh: 我的蜡烛掉了，火还在烧。
lines.en: My candle fell, and the flame still burns.

lines.zh: 我护住香炉，先护住它。
lines.en: I shield the censer first, always the censer.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，队伍不能散。
lines.en: Pain is pain, but the line must hold.

lines.zh: 我看见自己的血，腿有点软。
lines.en: I see my own blood, and my legs weaken.

lines.zh: 别告诉上面，我会自己包扎。
lines.en: Do not tell the tier above; I will bind it myself.

lines.zh: 那支蜡烛，能给我吗？
lines.en: That candle, could I have it?

lines.zh: 我攒了三个月的月钱，只够一枚。
lines.en: Three months of my stipend buys one of those.

lines.zh: 别在传道徒面前拿出来。
lines.en: Do not bring that out in the apostle's sight.

lines.zh: 给我一小块，我就当没看见你。
lines.en: Give me a small piece, and I saw nothing.

lines.zh: 我好久没闻到甜的味道了。
lines.en: It has been long since I smelled anything sweet.

lines.zh: 这个能换一支新蜡烛吗？
lines.en: Would this trade for a fresh candle?

lines.zh: 我伸手了，又收回来。
lines.en: I reach out, then pull my hand back.

lines.zh: 队伍里没人会分给我。
lines.en: No one in the procession would share with me.

lines.zh: 你放低一点，别举那么高。
lines.en: Keep it low; do not hold it so high.

lines.zh: 我咽了下口水，声音有点大。
lines.en: I swallow, and it sounds far too loud.

lines.zh: 对不起，香炉差点翻了。
lines.en: Forgive me; the censer nearly tipped.

lines.zh: 队伍不能乱，你退一步。
lines.en: The line must not break; step back.

lines.zh: 我的蜡烛歪了，火苗舔到手。
lines.en: My candle tilts and the flame licks my hand.

lines.zh: 别推，后面的人会跟着倒。
lines.en: Do not push; the ones behind will fall too.

lines.zh: 我踩到你的脚了，我不是故意。
lines.en: I stepped on your foot; it was not intended.

lines.zh: 灰洒了，我得重新捧一炉。
lines.en: The ash spilled; I must carry a fresh censer.

lines.zh: 这条道只够一个人过。
lines.en: This passage fits only one at a time.

lines.zh: 你撞歪了我的头巾。
lines.en: You knocked my headcloth crooked.

lines.zh: 我小声说了句借过，没人理。
lines.en: I whisper for passage, and no one heeds.

lines.zh: 站稳，别让传道徒看见。
lines.en: Steady yourself; do not let the apostle see.

lines.zh: 教众不许成家，规矩写着。
lines.en: The faithful may not marry; it is written.

lines.zh: 我们住通铺，一人一格。
lines.en: We sleep in rows, one alcove each.

lines.zh: 我连名字都被换过了。
lines.en: Even my name was taken and replaced.

lines.zh: 别问这个，墙会传话。
lines.en: Do not ask that; the walls pass word along.

lines.zh: 队伍里不许并肩走。
lines.en: In the procession, no two walk abreast.

lines.zh: 有人偷偷结伴，后来不见了。
lines.en: Some paired off in secret; they are gone now.

lines.zh: 我把这点心思压在香灰底下。
lines.en: I bury that thought under the incense ash.

lines.zh: 我只有一支蜡烛，分不了。
lines.en: I have only one candle; it cannot be split.

lines.zh: 圣所给的位置，一个人刚好。
lines.en: The place the Sanctum gives fits one person.

lines.zh: 别提了，我明天还要站前排。
lines.en: Say no more; I stand in the front row tomorrow.

lines.zh: 地上有半截蜡烛，还能点。
lines.en: Half a candle lies here; it still burns.

lines.zh: 我拾起别人掉的念珠，收好。
lines.en: I pick up dropped beads and put them away.

lines.zh: 这块布能补我的袖子。
lines.en: This cloth will patch my sleeve.

lines.zh: 一枚铜币，够买灯油了。
lines.en: One copper coin; enough for lamp oil.

lines.zh: 我把碎瓷片拢到墙角。
lines.en: I sweep the broken porcelain into the corner.

lines.zh: 谁掉的扣子，我放进兜里。
lines.en: Someone lost a button; I pocket it.

lines.zh: 这支断箭，得交给守卫。
lines.en: This broken arrow must go to the guardian.

lines.zh: 我弯腰太快，头巾滑了。
lines.en: I bend too fast and my headcloth slips.

lines.zh: 石头缝里有东西在反光。
lines.en: Something glints between the stones.

lines.zh: 捡到的都要登记，我知道。
lines.en: Everything found must be logged; I know.

lines.zh: 站住，你不该在这一层。
lines.en: Halt; you do not belong on this tier.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，别再躲。
lines.en: I see you now; stop hiding.

lines.zh: 我要喊了，真的会喊。
lines.en: I am going to shout; I truly will.

lines.zh: 传道徒说过，闯入者要围住。
lines.en: The apostle said trespassers must be surrounded.

lines.zh: 队伍散开，把两边堵上。
lines.en: Break the line and block both sides.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我们的蜡烛。
lines.en: You have crushed our candles.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，可我不会退。
lines.en: My hands shake, but I will not step back.

lines.zh: 今天是仪式的日子，你选错了。
lines.en: Today is a ritual day; you chose badly.

lines.zh: 后面的人已经去通报了。
lines.en: Someone behind me has already gone to report.

lines.zh: 别往祭坛跑，那边有人。
lines.en: Do not run for the altar; someone waits there.

lines.zh: 我记得你的靴子，别想混过去。
lines.en: I remember your boots; do not try to blend in.

lines.zh: 全员停在原地，等他下令。
lines.en: Everyone hold position until he gives the word.

lines.zh: 你身上带了铁，我闻得到。
lines.en: You carry iron; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我也许会挨罚，但你走不了。
lines.en: I may be punished, but you will not leave.

lines.zh: 蜡烛的火苗朝你倒，我看见了。
lines.en: The candle flames lean toward you. I saw it.

lines.zh: 我捧着香炉挡在路中间。
lines.en: I hold the censer up and block the middle of the path.

lines.zh: 你往左，左边也有人。
lines.en: Go left if you like; there are others on the left.

lines.zh: 我念错词了，可我还站着。
lines.en: I misquote the words, but I am still standing.

lines.zh: 蜡油滴在地上，标出你的位置。
lines.en: Wax marks the floor where you stood.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我不想第一个上。
lines.en: Do not force me; I would rather not go first.

lines.zh: 你把蜡烛全踢灭了。
lines.en: You have kicked out every candle.

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步乱了。
lines.en: I hear your steps losing their rhythm.

lines.zh: 这门后面是内殿，你进不去。
lines.en: The inner sanctum lies behind this door; you cannot enter.

lines.zh: 我举起香炉，灰会迷你的眼。
lines.en: I raise the censer; the ash will blind you.

lines.zh: 我们人多，你只有一个。
lines.en: There are many of us, and only one of you.

lines.zh: 你退到台阶下，我们就停下。
lines.en: Step below the stairs, and we will hold.

lines.zh: 我在等一句命令，别乱动。
lines.en: I am waiting for one command; do not move.

lines.zh: 你的影子在墙上，很长。
lines.en: Your shadow on the wall is very long.

lines.zh: 我把蜡烛放在地上，空出手。
lines.en: I set the candle down and free my hands.

lines.zh: 我站在台阶上，比你高半头。
lines.en: I stand on the step, half a head above you.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把晃，我跟着晃。
lines.en: Your torch sways, and I sway with it.

lines.zh: 别挤，队伍还没合拢。
lines.en: Do not crowd. The line has not closed yet.

lines.zh: 我把香炉举到胸口，准备撞。
lines.en: I lift the censer to my chest, ready to charge.

lines.zh: 我用香炉砸过去，灰撒了一地。
lines.en: I swing the censer; ash scatters everywhere.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我第一次打人。
lines.en: That was the first time I ever struck anyone.

lines.zh: 我抓着你的袖子往下拽。
lines.en: I grab your sleeve and drag you down.

lines.zh: 别怪我，是你先闯进来的。
lines.en: Do not blame me; you came in first.

lines.zh: 我的指节破了，血在袖子里。
lines.en: My knuckles split; blood hides in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我喊了一声，声音比预想的大。
lines.en: I shout, and it is louder than I expected.

lines.zh: 香灰糊了你一脸，我退开半步。
lines.en: Ash covers your face; I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 我推你撞上石柱，回声很闷。
lines.en: I shove you into the pillar; the echo is dull.

lines.zh: 队伍里有人在替我数着。
lines.en: Someone in the line is counting for me.

lines.zh: 我打得很乱，可我没跑。
lines.en: My blows are wild, but I did not run.

lines.zh: 蜡烛倒了，火沿着袍角爬。
lines.en: The candle falls, and fire climbs my hem.

lines.zh: 你踢中了我的膝，我跪下了。
lines.en: You catch my knee, and I go down.

lines.zh: 我抱住你的腰，等他们过来。
lines.en: I lock my arms around you and wait for the others.

lines.zh: 这一下是为弄坏的香炉。
lines.en: This one is for the censer you broke.

lines.zh: 香炉的边磕在你肩上。
lines.en: The rim of the censer catches your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我摔倒了，可手还抓着你不放。
lines.en: I fell, but my hand still holds you.

lines.zh: 我捧着蜡烛，站进队伍的空位。
lines.en: I take my candle and step into the empty place.

lines.zh: 今天轮到我站祭坛左侧。
lines.en: Today I stand at the left of the altar.

lines.zh: 袍子还是新的，领口有点硬。
lines.en: My robe is new; the collar still chafes.

lines.zh: 我提前到了，别人还没来。
lines.en: I arrived early; the others are not here.

lines.zh: 钟响第一下，我就该低头。
lines.en: At the bell's first stroke, I should bow my head.

lines.zh: 香点好了，烟是直的。
lines.en: The incense is lit, and the smoke rises straight.

lines.zh: 昨夜我梦见自己站上了讲台。
lines.en: Last night I dreamed I stood at the pulpit.

lines.zh: 我把念珠绕了三圈，才觉得对。
lines.en: I wind the beads three times before it feels right.

lines.zh: 这一排站十个人，我排第七。
lines.en: Ten of us fill this row; I am seventh.

lines.zh: 上面有脚步声，我立刻站直。
lines.en: Footsteps sound above; I straighten at once.

lines.zh: 我数着地砖，等仪式开始。
lines.en: I count the floor tiles while the ritual waits.

lines.zh: 灰落在肩上，我不敢拍。
lines.en: Ash settles on my shoulder; I dare not brush it.

lines.zh: 袍角烧起来了，我拍不灭。
lines.en: My hem is burning, and I cannot slap it out.

lines.zh: 台阶太高，我摔了两级。
lines.en: The steps are high; I fall down two of them.

lines.zh: 洗祭器的那池水，比看上去深。
lines.en: The basin for washing altar ware is deeper than it looks.

lines.zh: 有人炸了侧门，我被掀翻。
lines.en: Someone blew the side door; the blast throws me down.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的袖子，钉在地上。
lines.en: An arrow through my sleeve pins me to the floor.

lines.zh: 那道光进了我的眼睛，很冷。
lines.en: That light enters my eyes and feels cold.

lines.zh: 斋戒第三天，我看不清字。
lines.en: Third day of fasting, and I cannot read the words.

lines.zh: 雷打在高处，我趴下了。
lines.en: Thunder strikes high above; I drop flat.

lines.zh: 我往下看，什么都看不见。
lines.en: I look down and see nothing at all.
